intro: Five full-length papers of 100 engineering MCQs each, mixed across subjects in the proportions seen in recent PPSC, FPSC and KPPSC civil-engineer papers (see the Past-Paper Analysis file). General-ability questions are left out.
How to sit a test: one sitting, 90 minutes, no notes, no calculator except for numericals; mark answers on paper, then check with the key at the end.
Scoring: 70+ = ready; 55–69 = revise the subjects you lost marks in; below 55 = go back to the handbooks first.

Where the questions come from: the verified practice MCQs in your 14 handbooks, re-mixed and with answer options re-ordered, so the position of the right answer is new. The key names the handbook for each question so you can revise it.
Do not attempt two tests on the same day — space them a few days apart and fix weak subjects in between.
